description: MACA CMIP5 Statistically Downscaled Climate Projections is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Impacts Research Consortium; University of Idaho | Northwest Knowledge Network; USGS Northwest Climate Adaptation Science Center. Access climate projection data produced through the Multivariate Adaptive Constructed Analogs (MACA) method. The MACA archive contains output from 20 global climate models of the Coupled Model Inter-Comparison Project Phase 5 (CMIP5) for the contiguous United States. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
